_prereg: PAN-04/PAN-05 retrieval controls, frozen 2026-10-09 BEFORE any search over the catalog was run.
Catalog SHA: d6b2eeeca. A query passes at k if ANY path in 'answers' appears in the top k artifacts.
'lexical' queries share key words with their answer; 'paraphrase' queries deliberately do not.
Thresholds were chosen from downstream need (a seat finds the right file in the first 10 results
about 4 times in 5), not from any observed result:
POSITIVE  hybrid recall@10 >= 0.80 over all queries; fts recall@10 >= 0.60 on lexical;
NEGATIVE  fts returns 0 rows for every nonsense query; vector top-1 score for every nonsense
query is below the 25th percentile of the positive queries' vector top-1 scores.
CHEAT     a planted chunk with a unique marker is rank 1 by fts for the marker and in the vector
top 3 for a paraphrase of its content; after removal it is not returned at all.
INDETERMINATE if fewer than 15 queries have an answer that is chunked in the catalog.
Results are written to roles/Pan/reports/ with every row; thresholds are not moved after the run.
